usedFor: FlowyTeam tracks your goals and Zendesk Support runs your tickets, so “New Off-Track Key Result” runs “Create Support Ticket”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: An off-track key result becomes a ticket with an assignee and priority, so someone owns it.

watchOut: “Create Support Ticket” sets requester and assignee, so decide who should own these tickets first.
